name: team_planning_set_planned_level
description: Plan a promotion in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: the level a person holds from this step on. The plan keeps the level private to that person, so once they are forgotten it reads as removed. A planned level wins over a level corrected with team_planning_set_plan_value. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

level.description: The level, as the Org Graph names levels.
